text:
aj: Heads up — nightly integration red on hosted-api. Failing in tool-calling shard: multipart boundary in streaming response looks malformed -> host returns 422 and the job aborts. Anyone seen this? cc @maria

maria: ugh, can you paste the failing snippet and the shard id? I can take a look if it's quick.

aj: shard=37
logs:
```
Received chunk: --boundary
Content-Type: application/json

{"tool_result": "ok"}
--boundary--extra
```
Host replied 422: malformed multipart. Also seeing truncated content-length headers in proxy logs sometimes.

ryan: requesting a bisect + rerun on shard=37, this smells like the proxy upgrade from yesterday (gorel-proxy nginx 1.25) or the small streaming-encoding tweak in runtime. can we pin it?

deploy-bot: rerun requested by ryan for shard=37, job=ci/integration/nightly/shard-37. queued.

sre-bot: saw ~15 502 spikes in the same minute from hosted ingress, correlating with gorel-proxy deploy at 03:12 UTC. chunked encoding may have been mangled mid-stream.

maria: if proxy is suspect, try bypassing proxy for a local repro: curl to runtime directly with --raw and --no-buffer. aj can you share the curl you used?

aj: here's a minimal curl repro I used locally:
```
curl -v -H "Accept: multipart/mixed; boundary=boundary" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://hosted.api.redwood/reverse-toolcall" --no-buffer
```
Output intermittently shows `--boundary--extra` appended to the final boundary.

ryan: triage plan — 1) hold further gorel-proxy deploys, 2) rerun failing shard with higher verbosity, 3) run integ pinning nginx to 1.24. I'll open a quick infra PR to pin nginx.

maria: I'll add raw-byte logging in the runtime around multipart boundaries and instrument the proxy to dump request bodies for the failing window. aj, please add the full CI artifact to the ticket.

aj: done — pasted full CI log on the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7213. CI job link: https://ci.redwood/12345

maria: thanks — will follow up in the ticket and post findings here. :thumbsup:
